10	# Field points of a general test from points of its space — CHART-U(a) input 0
11	
12	`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3 freezes `chartLocus c λ` as a **subset of a general
13	test** `T`: a set of *points* `t : T.left`, at each of which one reads the fibre class of
14	`λ` at the residue field `κ(t)`.  `informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6 co-signs it and
15	lists three missing inputs (the shifted-datum constructor, the split predicate, the
16	descent/étale-image transports).
17	
18	**There is a fourth, prior to all three, and it is why nothing in the tree implements
19	`chartLocus`.**  The two vocabularies the definition has to join do not meet anywhere:
20	
21	* every witness/vanishing predicate in the tree is indexed by a prime of an **affine**
22	  base — `q : PrimeSpectrum B`, fibre field `q.asIdeal.ResidueField`
23	  (`Pic0ChartLocusOpen.lean:80`, `Pic0ChartLocusClass.lean:82`,
24	  `DivisorFamilyH1Locus.lean:363`);
25	* every *class* is evaluated at a field point only through a **morphism**
26	  `t : overSpec k K ⟶ T` for an abstract field `K` (`degAt`, `Pic0Functor.lean:54`;
27	  `pic0Subgroup`, `:107`).
28	
29	Nothing converts a point of `T.left` into either.  This file is that conversion, and it
30	is deliberately kept free of the chart layer: no `chartLocus`, no `θ`, no `Σ`, no
31	`divRep`.
32	
33	## Main declarations
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointField t` — the residue field `κ(t)` of a point of
36	  `T.left`, as a `k`-algebra (`Scheme.residueField`, with the `k`-algebra structure
37	  pulled back along the structure morphism).
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPoint t` — **the bridge**: the field point
39	  `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T` supported at `t`.  Built from mathlib's
40	  `Scheme.fromSpecResidueField`, whose triangle over `Spec k` is the `Over` datum.
41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPoint_base` — it really is supported at `t`: the unique
42	  point of `Spec κ(t)` maps to `t`.
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPoint_comp` — **naturality**, the law every well-definedness
44	  argument downstream runs on: for `f : T' ⟶ T` and `t : T'.left`, the field point of `t`
45	  followed by `f` is the field point of `f t`, up to the residue-field extension
46	  `κ(f t) → κ(t)` that `f` induces.  Stated as a commuting square rather than an equality
47	  of morphisms out of one object, because the two sides have different sources.
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointAffine` — the affine comparison: on `overSpec k A` the
49	  field point of a prime `q` is the residue-field point of `q`, so every affine-indexed
50	  predicate of the tree can be read through `testPoint`.
51	
52	## Why the affine-chart route is *not* the definition of record
53	
54	The obvious route (pick an affine open `U ∋ t`, use `q := U.2.primeIdealOf t` and
55	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U`, `PicEtUnit.lean:61`) needs a well-definedness lemma across the
56	choice of `U` before it can define anything.  Mathlib's `fromSpecResidueField` is already
57	canonical, so the chart-independence is *free* here and the chart comparison becomes a
58	lemma (`testPointField_affineOpen_iso`) instead of a side condition.  That is the whole
59	reason this file is short.
60	-/

78	/-! ## The residue field of a point of a test object -/
79	
80	/-- **The residue field of a point of a test object**, as a `k`-algebra: the scheme
81	residue field `κ(t)` of `Scheme.residueField`, with the `k`-algebra structure obtained by
82	transporting the structure morphism `T ⟶ Spec k` through `Spec.preimage`.
83	
84	This is the field at which the fibre of a class over `T` is read at `t`.  It is a bare
85	`Type u` field with a `k`-algebra instance, which is exactly the shape `degAt` and
86	`pic0Subgroup` quantify over. -/
87	def testPointField {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) : Type u :=
88	  T.left.residueField t
89	
90	instance instFieldTestPointField {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
91	    Field (testPointField t) :=
92	  inferInstanceAs (Field (T.left.residueField t))
93	
94	/-- The `k`-algebra structure on `κ(t)`: `Spec.preimage` of the composite
95	`Spec κ(t) ⟶ T.left ⟶ Spec k`. -/
96	instance instAlgebraTestPointField {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
97	    Algebra k (testPointField t) :=
98	  (Spec.preimage (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ T.hom)).hom.toAlgebra
99	
100	lemma algebraMap_testPointField {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
101	    algebraMap k (testPointField t)
102	      = (Spec.preimage (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ T.hom)).hom :=
103	  rfl

105	/-! ## The affine case: the test algebra also acts
106	
107	Over an affine test `overSpec k A` the residue field of a point is a `κ(t)`-algebra over `A`
108	as well as over `k`, and the two structures form a tower.  This is what the engine-facing
109	predicates of the tree require — `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing` takes
110	`[Algebra B L]` and `[IsScalarTower k B L]` — so without these two instances the
111	`testPoint`-indexed loci and the `PrimeSpectrum`-indexed loci cannot even be compared.
112	
113	Both come from the same source as the `k`-structure: `Spec.preimage` of the composite
114	`Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec A`, which for an affine test is the structure morphism itself. -/

116	section Affine

118	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
119	
120	/-- The `A`-algebra structure on the residue field of a point of an affine test: the
121	`Spec.preimage` of `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec A`.  (Over an affine test the carrier of the test object
122	*is* `Spec A`, so the composite is `fromSpecResidueField` alone.) -/
123	instance instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
124	    Algebra A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
125	  (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)).hom.toAlgebra
126	
127	lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
128	    algebraMap A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
129	      = (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)).hom :=
130	  rfl
131	
132	/-- **The tower `k → A → κ(t)`** on an affine test.  `Spec` of the tower identity is the
133	factorisation of `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec k` through `Spec A`, which is the `Over` triangle of the
134	affine test object — the same identity `isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra`
135	(`Picard/Pic0Theta.lean:358`) proves for an abstract field point, here at the canonical
136	residue-field point. -/
137	instance instIsScalarTowerTestPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
138	    IsScalarTower k A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) := by
139	  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' ?_
140	  -- Both algebra maps are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`; `Spec.preimage`
141	  -- is a bijection on homs, so it suffices to compare the two morphisms, and there the
142	  -- identity is the `Over` triangle of the affine test object: `(overSpec k A).hom` is by
143	  -- definition `Spec.map (algebraMap k A)`.
144	  have hcomp : ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ (overSpec k A).hom)
145	      = (overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
146	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl
147	  -- `Spec.preimage` is injective on the composite, and the composite identity is `hcomp`.
148	  have hw := congrArg (fun f => (Spec.preimage f).hom) hcomp
149	  have hsplit : (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
150	        ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).hom
151	      = (algebraMap A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)).comp
152	          (algebraMap k A) := by
153	    have : ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
154	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
155	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)
156	            ≫ Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)) := by
157	      rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_preimage]
158	      rfl
159	    rw [this, Spec.preimage_map]
160	    rfl
161	  exact hw.trans hsplit
162	
163	end Affine

165	/-! ## The field point -/
166	
167	/-- **The bridge: a point of `T.left` as a field point of `T`.**
168	
169	`t : T.left` names the test object morphism `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T` whose carrier is
170	mathlib's canonical `Scheme.fromSpecResidueField` and whose triangle over `Spec k` holds
171	by the very definition of the `k`-algebra structure on `κ(t)`.
172	
173	This is the missing input 0 of CHART-U(a): with it, `{t : T.left | P (fibre of λ at
174	κ(t))}` is a legal `Set T.left` for any predicate `P` on classes over a field, and that
175	is what `chartLocus` is. -/
176	def testPoint {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
177	    overSpec k (testPointField t) ⟶ T :=
178	  Over.homMk (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t)
179	    (Spec.map_preimage (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ T.hom)).symm
180	
181	@[simp]
182	lemma testPoint_left {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
183	    (testPoint t).left = T.left.fromSpecResidueField t :=
184	  rfl
185	
186	/-- **The field point is supported at the point it came from**: the unique point of
187	`Spec κ(t)` maps to `t`.  (`Spec` of a field has a unique point, so this pins the support
188	completely.) -/
189	@[simp]
190	lemma testPoint_base {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left)
191	    (s : (overSpec k (testPointField t)).left) :
192	    (testPoint t).left.base s = t :=
193	  Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply t s
194	
195	/-! ## Naturality along a morphism of tests
196	
197	The law every downstream well-definedness argument runs on.  A morphism `f : T' ⟶ T`
198	does not send the field point of `t` to the field point of `f t` on the nose — the two
199	have *different sources*, `Spec κ(t)` and `Spec κ(f t)`.  What is true, and what the
200	transports of `w4-datb` §1.6 use, is that the square through the induced residue-field
201	extension `κ(f t) → κ(t)` commutes. -/
202	
203	/-- **The residue-field extension a morphism of tests induces at a point**, as a
204	`k`-algebra map `κ(f t) → κ(t)`.  This is `Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap` with its
205	`k`-algebra structure read off; it is the extension along which every fibre-field
206	predicate has to be invariant for a locus over `T` to pull back to one over `T'`. -/
207	def testPointFieldMap {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
208	    CommRingCat.of (testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))
209	      ⟶ CommRingCat.of (testPointField (T := T') t) :=
210	  f.left.residueFieldMap t
211	
212	/-- The residue-field extension of `testPointFieldMap`, as an algebra structure: `κ(t)` is
213	a `κ(f t)`-algebra.  This is the shape the fibre-field invariance lemmas of
214	`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean` consume (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`
215	takes `[Algebra L L']`). -/
216	@[reducible]
217	def testPointFieldAlgebra {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
218	    Algebra (testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t)) (testPointField (T := T') t) :=
219	  (testPointFieldMap f t).hom.toAlgebra
220	
221	/-- **The naturality square of the bridge**: the field point of `t : T'.left` composed
222	with `f` is the field point of `f t` precomposed with `Spec` of the residue-field
223	extension.  Both sides are morphisms `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T` in the slice.
224	
225	This is `Scheme.Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField` in the over category,
226	and it is the only law CHART-U(b)'s transports (i)/(ii) need from this file. -/
227	lemma testPoint_comp_left {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
228	    (testPoint t).left ≫ f.left
229	      = Spec.map (testPointFieldMap f t) ≫ (testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left :=
230	  (f.left.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField t).symm
231	
232	end
